name: Bardiya of Tuon
source:
Bardiya of Tuon is a member of The Class of Exemplary Acolytes. He was a street medic in the Ikkaryonic Revolution, on the side of the revolutionaries, and still has some connections with Paritist underground organizations. He specializes in Anima scripting [gene engineering].

Despite having the same birthplace name as Kamrusepa of Tuon, they aren't actually related. They are both from Rhunbard, where birthplace names aren't normally used. Since they were both born in the city of Tuon, they took the same birthplace name. Nothing is known about Bardiya's patronymic.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Bardiya_of_Tuon]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
